name: lookup_entry_links
description:
Looks up Entry Links — the relationships that reference a given Entry in the Knowledge Catalog (formerly known as Dataplex).

Entry Links connect Entries, for example:
- Business glossary terms attached to data assets or columns (`definition` links).
- Synonym or related relationships between glossary terms (`synonym` / `related` links).
- dbt resources imported from a dbt project: `reference` links between a dbt model and the models, sources or BigQuery tables it references, and `schema-join` links between joinable columns.
- Custom relationships defined by user-created Entry Link Types.

**When to use**:
- After `search_entries` or `lookup_entry`, to find which glossary terms describe a table or column, or which data assets a glossary term is attached to.
- For dbt: with a dbt model Entry, `entry_mode: SOURCE` returns its `reference` links to the Entries it references; with a BigQuery table Entry, `entry_mode: TARGET` returns the `reference` links from dbt models that reference it.

parameters.description: Lookup Entry Links request in the simplified MCP format.

entry.description: Required. The resource name of the referred Entry. Entry Links that reference this Entry are returned. Must be in the format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/entryGroups/{entry_group_id}/entries/{entry_id}` Example for a BigQuery table: `projects/{project_id_or_number}/locations/{location}/entryGroups/@bigquery/entries/bigquery.googleapis.com/projects/{project_id}/datasets/{dataset_id}/tables/{table_id}` Example for a dbt model imported into a custom entry group: `projects/{project_id_or_number}/locations/{location}/entryGroups/{dbt_entry_group_id}/entries/model.{dbt_project}.{model_name}` This is the same value returned in the `dataplexEntry.name` field of the `SearchEntries` response.

entryLinkTypes.description: Optional. Entry Link Type resource names to filter the response by. If empty, Entry Links of all types are returned. At most 10 Entry Link Types can be specified. Format: `projects/{project_id_or_number}/locations/{location}/entryLinkTypes/{entry_link_type_id}` Common system Entry Link Types: - `projects/dataplex-types/locations/global/entryLinkTypes/definition` (glossary term attached to a data asset or column) - `projects/dataplex-types/locations/global/entryLinkTypes/synonym` (synonym glossary terms) - `projects/dataplex-types/locations/global/entryLinkTypes/related` (related glossary terms) - `projects/dataplex-types/locations/global/entryLinkTypes/reference` (directed reference from one Entry to another, e.g. a dbt model to the models, sources or BigQuery tables it references) - `projects/dataplex-types/locations/global/entryLinkTypes/schema-join` (undirected column-level join between two Entries, e.g. between two dbt models)

entryMode.description: Optional. Controls which directional Entry Links are returned. - `ENTRY_MODE_UNSPECIFIED`: Returns both directional and non-directional Entry Links that reference the Entry. - `SOURCE`: Returns only directional Entry Links where the Entry is the source (e.g. for a dbt model, the `reference` links to the Entries it references). - `TARGET`: Returns only directional Entry Links where the Entry is the target (e.g. for a BigQuery table, the `reference` links from dbt models that reference it, or the `definition` links from glossary terms attached to it).
x-google-enum-descriptions: Unspecified entry mode. Returns both directional and non-directional entry links which references the entry.
Returns all directed entry links which references the entry as source.
Return all directed entry links which references the entry as target.

location.description: Required. The location to which the request should be attributed. This should match the location of the `entry` (e.g. `us-central1` or `global`).

pageSize.description: Optional. Maximum number of Entry Links to return. If unspecified, at most 10 Entry Links are returned. The maximum value is 10; values above 10 are coerced to 10.

pageToken.description: Optional. Page token received from a previous `LookupEntryLinks` call. Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page. When paginating, all other parameters must match the call that provided the page token.

projectId.description: Required. The project ID to which the request should be attributed.
